dialogues.speaker: Wandering Phantom
dialogues.text: Ah, shucks, look at me talking away — I totally forgot, I've still got fuel to move!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, but we brought all the fuel with us! What's this guy talking about...

dialogues.speaker: Wandering Phantom
dialogues.text: Alright, I'd better get back. See you later, scaredy-cat! Hehe. It's nearly time for... my shift...
